title: Nuclear Replay shot list
description: Camera directions for a replay. The director switches to each shot at its time and keeps it until the next shot. Times are replay seconds since the demo started (the 't' values shown by 'nr events').

shots.description: Shots in time order. The director sorts them by t.

lighting.description: Lighting defaults for every shot (a shot's own lighting keys win key by key). Leave it out to render the recorded lighting.

t.description: Replay time in seconds when this shot starts.

camera.description: orbit: circles the target. chase: behind the target. chase_cine: the director's cinematic chase (level horizon, holds its last pose when the target is gone). cockpit: pilot's view. tv: a spotter/flyby camera. free: free camera. relative: fixed offset from the target.

target.description: host: the hosting player's aircraft. auto: follows the host and cuts to each new missile. latest_missile / latest_host_missile: newest missile (of anyone / of the host). unit:<id>: a unit id from 'nr events'. name:<text>: first unit whose name contains the text.

fov.description: Field of view in degrees. Optional; 30-90 looks natural.

hold.description: Seconds to stay on a destroyed target before cutting to the nearest live aircraft. Default 3. A detonated missile holds a still view of its explosion.

then.description: Where to cut once the target is gone and the hold is over, instead of the nearest live aircraft. victim_cut uses hold 0 and then the victim, so the cut lands at the moment the missile hits.

backlight.description: chase_cine, flyby, track_from and keyframe cameras: put the camera on the far side of the subject from the sun, looking into the sun (silhouette and rim light).

backlight_off.description: Degrees between the sun and the subject as seen from the camera. Default 15.

backlight_side.description: Which side of the subject the sun appears on. Default right.

backlight_pitch.description: Degrees; positive puts the sun higher in frame than the subject. Default 0.

backlight_at.description: track_from: seconds ahead at which the subject crosses the sun line. Default 2.

backlight_height.description: chase_cine: metres added straight up to the sun-locked offset. Default 0.

backlight_min.description: Metres: nearest ground spot on the sun line for agl cameras. Default 60.

backlight_max.description: Metres: farthest ground spot on the sun line for agl cameras. Default 8000.

time_of_day.description: Hours. Moves the sun along the map's own path: 6.5 dawn, 17.3 golden hour, 17.8 dusk on most maps; the sun light is off from about 17.9.

sun_azimuth.description: Compass degrees toward the sun (0 = +z, 90 = +x), turning the sun's path about the vertical; or "camera": the sun in front of the camera, sun_camera_off degrees right of the view, locked at the shot's first frame. The elevation still comes from time_of_day.

sun_camera_off.description: Degrees right of the view for sun_azimuth "camera" (negative: left). Default 15.

fog.description: Multiplier on the game's haze (fog density): 0.25 clear air, 0.5 light, 2 hazy, 4 thick. 1 is the recorded haze.

weather.description: The game's weather amount: 0 clear to 1 storm (cloud cover and overcast light).

cloud_height.description: Height of the cloud layer in metres above sea level.
